correction: Original classic az2 My Torrents is a closeable MAIN TabbedMDI entry. The false argument in setupSidebarClassic is overridden. The earlier noncloseable-original inference was incomplete and is superseded here.
cause_of_prior_error: The original audit stopped at the factory closeable=false argument and did not carry virtual dispatch through TabbedEntry.setCloseable/isCloseable for isMainMDI=true. The argument itself was recorded correctly, but the resulting permanence conclusion was wrong.

exact_classic_path.fact: Utils.isAZ2UI selects new TabbedMDI(), not SideBar; builds this exact MDI and passes it into MainMDISetup.setupSideBar.
Sets isMainMDI=true and destroyEntriesOnDeactivate=false; main tabs use tabsauto.config. Retaining a view when merely deactivated is different from refusing explicit close.
Registers SIDEBAR_SECTION_LIBRARY/My Torrents via skinref library with closeable=false, then shows it. SB_Transfers is constructed with vuze_ui=false.
Constructs TabbedEntry(this,skin,id), sets skin/title/datasource and calls the virtual entry.setCloseable(closeable).

setCloseable forces its input to true whenever getMDI().isMainMDI. isCloseable separately returns mainMDI || super.isCloseable. The false factory argument therefore cannot make classic main My Torrents noncloseable.
The actual SWT tab show-close flag uses effective isCloseable(), so the override also reaches the tab control.

distinct_paths.fact: The non-az2 path uses SideBar and modern library creator with closeable=false. It is not a main TabbedEntry and cannot justify classic permanence. SideBarEntrySWT does not provide the main-TabbedEntry override.
Parameterized constructor explicitly sets isMainMDI=false. Embedded tabs can honor their configured false value; they are not the classic top-level My Torrents tab.

distinct_paths.kind: Classic Library content versus MDI wrapper
distinct_paths.fact: library skin creates SBC_LibraryView/content. Content/table implementation does not change the effective main TabbedEntry closeability. No permanent-My-Torrents close veto was found in the classic factory or these content classes.

file_close_tab_and_reopen.fact: Classic menu uses MainMenuV2 and includes MenuFactory.addCloseTabMenuItem.

File Close Tab uses MainWindow.menu.file.closetab with Meta+W: Ctrl+W on Linux. Close Window is a distinct Meta+Shift+W action. This is view/tab closure, not torrent removal or application/profile/worker shutdown.
Menu targets the selected main entry, enables it when effective isCloseable(), and calls mdi.closeEntry(entry,true). Thus a selected classic My Torrents entry is eligible.

Generic MdiCloseListener vetoes are honored. This addendum establishes effective closeability and built-in close path; it does not promise arbitrary plugin/listener instances can never veto. No special permanent My Torrents veto was found in the inspected classic construction/content path.

Closes/removes the MDI entry and autoopen record and destroys its view. It does not remove the registered creation factory or remove torrents. No unconditional default-home reopening is present in this close path; separate startup autoopen fallback timers are not a permanence rule.
Normal user close can activate a previous live entry using bounded64 selection history. It has no My Torrents-specific noncloseable exception; if no previous entry remains, this helper returns null.
View My Torrents/Ctrl+1 reuses the open entry or recreates the missing entry from the still-registered factory and activates it.

saved-services-window-review.json: guarded native tab-close/hidden-button observations remain valid for that source version. They establish a preview adaptation, not exact original classic close policy.
Do not rewrite old reviews/tests or infer their recorded runtime outcomes were fabricated. Update future policy/tests under a new explicit close/reopen slice.
next_native_contract_guidance: Ultimate classic behavior should allow File Close Tab/Ctrl+W and tab close for My Torrents as well as auxiliary main tabs, subject to actual close eligibility/lifecycle rules.
Closing a tab must not stop/remove downloads, tear down profile ownership or quit the application; reopening via View/Ctrl+1 must restore a safe single page and reject stale result targeting.

A bounded native implementation may retain detached library widgets/model to preserve safe selection, provided tab removal/reopen behavior is correct and retained backing is explicitly a native adaptation, not claimed exact Java destruction equivalence.

Cover last-tab/empty-main-area behavior, close/reopen during pending file details, and keyboard/menu/tab-X consistency with generated fixtures before claiming parity. Keep whole-window cancellation/lease shutdown separate.
Existing Escape cancellation policy must not be silently replaced by the original main TabbedMDI Escape/Ctrl+F4 shortcuts; reconcile that independently.
